hypothesis: The champion portfolio's own cross-fitted uncertainty (small margin |p-0.5|) locates the FIT rows where an extra rich-view LGBM member carries incremental signal; upweighting those rows (3x) yields a specialist whose equal-logit blend with the portfolio reference beats the reference by >= +5e-5 AUC on fold-0 while decorrelating (Spearman < 0.995).
why_distinct: Margins come from the portfolio's FIT-side OOF (route+aux10, never the eval fold's labels) and target UNCERTAINTY, not error-based difficulty (H19-A used difficulty weights and netted ~0) and not label-noise hard pairs (row 75). Row 74 next_action is exactly 'FIT-only margins'.

decision_rule.port_delta: AUC(equal-logit blend(candidate, PORTFOLIO_REF)) - AUC(PORTFOLIO_REF) on primary fold-0
decision_rule.descriptive_only: standalone AUC, tie-subset AUCs, logit Pearson - never the decision rule

anti_leakage: margins and the tie threshold are computed from PORTFOLIO_REF OOF only; threshold tau = 30% quantile of FIT-row margins; fold-0 rows are labeled near-tie by |port-0.5| <= tau using fold-0 PREDICTIONS (no labels)
view assembled fold-safe (TE fit on FIT via ViewBuilder.assemble)
inner 10% ES split carved from FIT-train only, seed 1 (ES labels never used for weighting)
fold-0 labels are read only at final metric computation

protocol.view: full (285-feature certified rich view, fold-safe TE)
protocol.margin_source: PORTFOLIO_REF OOF on FIT rows; tau = 30th percentile of |p-0.5| on FIT rows
protocol.training: LightGBM on ALL FIT rows with sample_weight = 3.0 where margin <= tau else 1.0
protocol.candidate: specialist predict_proba on all fold-0 rows
descriptive: portfolio AUC on near-tie fold-0 subset vs blend AUC on same subset
Spearman candidate vs PORTFOLIO_REF, logit Pearson
